title: Flock of swallows
desc: About eleven barn swallows rising in a loose diagonal flock, in fine 19th-century engraving line: hatched wings, stippled breasts, white throats. Our main motif. Fine line, so use it large.

title: Pomegranates
desc: Two pomegranates, one whole and one cut open, as a two-colour linocut: black key block over a flat red that sits slightly out of register.

title: Oak leaf and acorn on a twig
desc: One oak leaf and one acorn on a sweeping twig. Solid black, thin cut veins, cut-out acorn cup.

title: Acorn
desc: A single acorn with a ribbed nut, speckled cap and stray gouge marks around the edge.

title: Oak leaf, down-right
desc: An oak leaf angled down and to the right, with white cut veins and stray cuts.

title: Oak leaf, up-right
desc: An oak leaf angled up and to the right, with white cut veins and stray cuts.

title: Two acorns with an oak leaf
desc: A pair of acorns with crosshatched cups and a small oak leaf above.

title: Pinecone, bold
desc: A tilted pinecone in strong black and white, with chunky outlined scales that go ragged at the tip.

title: Pinecone hanging from a twig
desc: A pinecone hanging from a pine twig with long, fine needles. A thin pen drawing, best used large.

title: Hanging fruit and leaves
desc: Two round fruit with leaf clusters as a cut-paper silhouette. Thin white gaps do the drawing. Vertical, so it suits a margin or divider.

title: Round flowers on a branching stem
desc: Pom-pom flower heads on a long, thin branching stem. Light and airy, with heavy dots on a hairline.

title: Tulips in loose brush line
desc: Five tulip-like flowers in loose, tapering brush strokes. Source image was AI-generated, so mood reference.

title: Lily stem
desc: A lily stem in a few swelling brush lines, with leaves left partly open.

title: Wildflowers
desc: Three wildflowers and two buds in scratchy pen line with dark centres. Clip-art crop, so a draft.

title: Flowering branch, cropped
desc: A flowering branch as a flat silhouette, cropped so it runs off the frame. Works as a background or tile.

title: Mountain range with a gold sun
desc: A range of three peaks carved in strong black and white, with short cut strokes for the plain below and a small gold sun above.

title: Mountain range
desc: The same range of peaks without the sun, cropped tight to the mountains and the plain.
